dailyBrief: As New York and California prepare to implement age gating rules for AI applications in the new year, businesses must adapt to these regulatory changes to ensure compliance and protect user data. Meanwhile, the release of a free AI image upscaler on GitHub, leveraging Vulkan GPU acceleration, presents opportunities for companies to enhance their visual content without significant investment. On the financial front, OpenAI is reportedly tightening its budget, with usage of GPT-6.2 being cut, leading to Astra and Sol hitting their operational limits 40% and 25% faster, respectively. This shift may signal a broader trend in the AI sector towards cost efficiency, prompting businesses to reassess their AI strategies and resource allocations. Additionally, Anthropic's release of a more concise version of its GRH Lean verification could streamline processes for companies integrating AI into their operations.
